title: Shi No Numa Main Easter Egg
description: Steps: - First, head to the [Monolith](https://mapgenie.io/call-of-duty-vanguard/maps/zombies-shi-no-numa?locationIds=1084265) in the Doctor's Quarters Exterior. - Kell Boom Schriers near it to remove the vines, then head into the Doctor's Quarters. - Acquire the Wunderwaffe DG-2 from the [Wunderwaffe DG-2 Easter Egg](https://mapgenie.io/call-of-duty-vanguard/maps/zombies-shi-no-numa?locationIds=1084226) or the mystery box. - Head to the table in the back to find a [Symbol Note](https://mapgenie.io/call-of-duty-vanguard/maps/zombies-shi-no-numa?locationIds=1084266) that is partially obstructed. Use a molotov or a Thermite grenade to reveal all the symbols. - Next, collect the three Cypher Wheel Pieces found around the map: - [Cypher Wheel Part](https://mapgenie.io/call-of-duty-vanguard/maps/zombies-shi-no-numa?locationIds=1084199) - [Cypher Wheel Part](https://mapgenie.io/call-of-duty-vanguard/maps/zombies-shi-no-numa?locationIds=1084211) - [Cypher Wheel Part](https://mapgenie.io/call-of-duty-vanguard/maps/zombies-shi-no-numa?locationIds=1084259) - Place all three onto the Monolith. A coded symbol will need to be set on it, based on the symbols on the Symbol Note sheet and the Kanji on three different notes around the map: - [Kanji Note](https://mapgenie.io/call-of-duty-vanguard/maps/zombies-shi-no-numa?locationIds=1084267) - [Kanji Note](https://mapgenie.io/call-of-duty-vanguard/maps/zombies-shi-no-numa?locationIds=1084268) - [Kanji Note](https://mapgenie.io/call-of-duty-vanguard/maps/zombies-shi-no-numa?locationIds=1084269) - Put the code into the Monolith then interact with the glowing pillars around the area, causing a lockdown. - If playing in multiplayer, all pillars need to be interacted with at the same time. - Zombies glowing in a blue aura will spawn, kill them near the monolith using the Wunderwaffe DG-2. - The lockdown is on a time limit and will require flipping rounds to reactivate it. - Once complete, head to the Flogger Courtyard and kill zombies using the [Trap](https://mapgenie.io/call-of-duty-vanguard/maps/zombies-shi-no-numa?locationIds=1084214) to fill the [Zombie Blood Fountain](https://mapgenie.io/call-of-duty-vanguard/maps/zombies-shi-no-numa?locationIds=1084275). - When drinking from the Zombie Blood Fountain, there is a time limit in the special state. It can be drank from multiple times if the timer runs out. - There are two Relic Mirror Fragments that need to be gathered: - Red Orb Relic Mirror Fragment: - Drink from the Zombie Blood Fountain and head inside the central building to find a red orb. - Follow the red orb until it drops the Relic Mirror Fragment, then pick it up. - Map Relic Mirror Fragment: - Head inside the central building and read the [Wall Map](https://mapgenie.io/call-of-duty-vanguard/maps/zombies-shi-no-numa?locationIds=1084276) in the War Room to find the red X, denoting where the Relic Mirror Fragment is. - Head to the location to find the Relic Mirror Fragment in the ceiling. - Shoot it down and grab the Relic Mirror Fragment. - Once both are acquired, head to the [Stone Altar](https://mapgenie.io/call-of-duty-vanguard/maps/zombies-shi-no-numa?locationIds=1084277) and place both pieces down. - Interact with the nearby blue orbs that spawn. - If playing in multiplayer, all orbs need to be interacted with at the same time. - Chase down each orb and shoot it until it returns to the Dig Site. - Once the orb(s) are back in the Dig Site, interact with them to start a lockdown. - Once again, shoot the blue glowing zombies with the Wunderwaffe DG-2 to charge the relic, then shoot the boss until their mask breaks. - Once all three masks are destroyed, grab the relic to complete the easter egg.

title: Wunderwaffe DG-2 Wonder Weapon Easter Egg
description: Steps: - First, grab the [Weapon Barrel](https://mapgenie.io/call-of-duty-vanguard/maps/zombies-shi-no-numa?locationIds=1084227) inside the Fishing Hut. - Head to the [Radio Box](https://mapgenie.io/call-of-duty-vanguard/maps/zombies-shi-no-numa?locationIds=1084270) in the Comm Room Exterior and insert the weapon barrel inside. - Flip rounds, causing the Radio Box to be struck by lighting. Defend the Radio Box. - Once completed, pick up Weapon Barrel from the Radio Box and head to the [Radio](https://mapgenie.io/call-of-duty-vanguard/maps/zombies-shi-no-numa?locationIds=1084252) inside to acquire the [Charged Vacuum Tube](https://mapgenie.io/call-of-duty-vanguard/maps/zombies-shi-no-numa?locationIds=1084271). - Off the nearby table, grab the [Electrical Fuse](https://mapgenie.io/call-of-duty-vanguard/maps/zombies-shi-no-numa?locationIds=1084253) and head to the Storage Hut. - Activate the [Trap](https://mapgenie.io/call-of-duty-vanguard/maps/zombies-shi-no-numa?locationIds=1084235) inside, which will cause the electrical box controlling the trap to break. - Place the Electrical Fuse inside, then charge it by killing zombies with the trap. - Finally, head to the [Tesla Coil](https://mapgenie.io/call-of-duty-vanguard/maps/zombies-shi-no-numa?locationIds=1084273) in the Excavation room and lure a Zaballa inside. - Zaballa starts spawning at Round 15. - Let the Zaballa use its attacks near the Tesla Coil until it's charged, then pick up the [Charged Vacuum Tube](https://mapgenie.io/call-of-duty-vanguard/maps/zombies-shi-no-numa?locationIds=1084274). - Head to the [Workbench](https://mapgenie.io/call-of-duty-vanguard/maps/zombies-shi-no-numa?locationIds=1084234) to craft the Wunderwaffe DG-2.

description: Steps: - First, head to the Fishing Hut and shoot the four Metal Pans around the building: - [Pan](https://mapgenie.io/call-of-duty-vanguard/maps/zombies-shi-no-numa?locationIds=1084288) - [Pan](https://mapgenie.io/call-of-duty-vanguard/maps/zombies-shi-no-numa?locationIds=1084289) - [Pan](https://mapgenie.io/call-of-duty-vanguard/maps/zombies-shi-no-numa?locationIds=1084290) - [Pan](https://mapgenie.io/call-of-duty-vanguard/maps/zombies-shi-no-numa?locationIds=1084291) - After all four are shot, head to the back room of the Fishing Hut and interact with the [Doll](https://mapgenie.io/call-of-duty-vanguard/maps/zombies-shi-no-numa?locationIds=1084292) on the ground. - Head to the bridge just outside the Fishing Hut and shoot the Doll spinning around the bridge posts. - Keep shooting the Doll until it disappears. - Head back to the back room where the Doll originally was and interact with it to play the song and acquire a Max Ammo power-up.

description: Steps: - There are three Mr. Peeks parts around the map that need to be acquired, which all require being under the affects of the zombie blood from the [Zombie Blood Fountain](https://mapgenie.io/call-of-duty-vanguard/maps/zombies-shi-no-numa?locationIds=1084275): - [Mr. Peeks Part](https://mapgenie.io/call-of-duty-vanguard/maps/zombies-shi-no-numa?locationIds=1084300) - [Mr. Peeks Part](https://mapgenie.io/call-of-duty-vanguard/maps/zombies-shi-no-numa?locationIds=1084302) - Once can be picked up after getting Mr. Peeks from the mystery box while under the zombie blood effect. - Once the third is acquired, ten Bonus Points power-ups and a Fire Sale power-up will spawn.

title: Zombie Head Hunting Easter Egg
description: Steps: - After round five, a zombie will be hiding around outside the map. - The zombie will show up on the minimap. - If approached too closely, the zombies will disappear until next round. - Depending where it spawns, you will need to shoot it with a specific gun: - [Hiding Zombie](https://mapgenie.io/call-of-duty-vanguard/maps/zombies-shi-no-numa?locationIds=1085202): SMG - [Hiding Zombie](https://mapgenie.io/call-of-duty-vanguard/maps/zombies-shi-no-numa?locationIds=1085201): Assault Rifle - [Hiding Zombie](https://mapgenie.io/call-of-duty-vanguard/maps/zombies-shi-no-numa?locationIds=1085200): Shotgun - Depending on which gun is required, when shot, you will be brought into a special trial: - Both trials require shooting a floating head until it is destroyed - SMG/Assault Rifle: - Shoot the blue orbs that the head spawns. If too many build up, the trial will fail. - Don't shoot the red orbs that the head spawns. If shot, the trial will fail. - Shotgun: - Shoot the floating head only when it's not red. If shot while red, the trial will fail. - If successfully completed, the head will reward you with 2,500 essence, a max ammo, and a chest with a Pack-A-Punched gun.

title: Free Ray Gun and Death Machine Easter Egg
description: Steps: - First, dig up the [Dig Spots](https://mapgenie.io/call-of-duty-vanguard/maps/zombies-terra-maledicta?search=dig_spot%20%26%26%20category%3A28626) around the map until Lost Tome Pages drop. - Continue digging until four lost tome pages have been acquired. - While digging, you'll also come across a Ray Gun that comes out of the ground with zombies spawning nearby. - The Ray Gun will move to a [Sealed Room](https://mapgenie.io/call-of-duty-vanguard/maps/zombies-terra-maledicta?locationIds=1067352), which will be opened at the end of the Easter Egg. - Once all four are acquired and the Ray Gun has been moved from the dig spot, head to the Sealed Room. - Interact with the door four times to place the pages onto the door. - Each page needs to be placed in a specific order. The order is random for each game, so the solution requires trial and error. - Once all four are placed, the room will open, revealing the Ray Gun and a Death Machine.

title: Bonus Points Easter Egg
description: Steps: - First, dig up the [Dig Spots](https://mapgenie.io/call-of-duty-vanguard/maps/zombies-terra-maledicta?search=dig_spot%20%26%26%20category%3A28626) around the map until a red orb spawns. - Chase and shoot the red orb in the sky until it drops to the ground. - Interact with the red orb to spawn ten Bonus Points power-ups. - This can be done multiple times in one game.

title: Free Sacrificial Heart Easter Egg
description: Steps: - First, dig up the [Dig Spots](https://mapgenie.io/call-of-duty-vanguard/maps/zombies-terra-maledicta?search=dig_spot%20%26%26%20category%3A28626) around the map until a blue orb spawns and corrupts you. - While corrupted, your health will be cut in half. - Find a red rune scattered around the map and bury the heart inside it. - Once buried, you will receive a free sacrificial heart.

title: Random Loot Easter Egg
description: Steps: - First, dig up the [Dig Spots](https://mapgenie.io/call-of-duty-vanguard/maps/zombies-terra-maledicta?search=dig_spot%20%26%26%20category%3A28626) around the map until an antenna drops. - Place the antenna on the [Antenna Radio](https://mapgenie.io/call-of-duty-vanguard/maps/zombies-terra-maledicta?locationIds=1067363) against the wall on Merchant Road. - Around the map, three other antennas will now need to be rotated by interacting with the radio: - [Antenna Radio](https://mapgenie.io/call-of-duty-vanguard/maps/zombies-terra-maledicta?locationIds=1067369) - [Antenna Radio](https://mapgenie.io/call-of-duty-vanguard/maps/zombies-terra-maledicta?locationIds=1067368) - [Antenna Radio](https://mapgenie.io/call-of-duty-vanguard/maps/zombies-terra-maledicta?locationIds=1067366) - After rotating the last antenna, a large amount of Sturmkriegers will spawn. - Once defeating the last one, it will drop a chest with a variety of loot.

title: Decimator Shield Easter Egg
description: Steps: - First, complete a portal objective at one of the [Challenge Portals,](https://mapgenie.io/call-of-duty-vanguard/maps/zombies-terra-maledicta?search=challenge_portal%20%26%26%20category%3A28646) - Once you've unlocked the Merchant Road area to the east of the Temple, head close to the [Decimator Shield](https://mapgenie.io/call-of-duty-vanguard/maps/zombies-terra-maledicta?locationIds=1067377) trapped on a crystal to get a dialog sequence. - Next, complete another portal objective. - Then, head to the Tents area and interact with the [Ancient Corrupt Rune](https://mapgenie.io/call-of-duty-vanguard/maps/zombies-terra-maledicta?locationIds=1067238) to spawn a challenge portal. - Once completed, head back to the Decimator Shield to get another dialog sequence. - Next, head around the map and destroy four yellow crystals: - [Yellow Crystal](https://mapgenie.io/call-of-duty-vanguard/maps/zombies-terra-maledicta?locationIds=1067399) - [Yellow Crystal](https://mapgenie.io/call-of-duty-vanguard/maps/zombies-terra-maledicta?locationIds=1067397) - [Yellow Crystal](https://mapgenie.io/call-of-duty-vanguard/maps/zombies-terra-maledicta?locationIds=1067395) - [Yellow Crystal](https://mapgenie.io/call-of-duty-vanguard/maps/zombies-terra-maledicta?locationIds=1067392) - Once all four are destroyed, head to the second [Ancient Corrupt Rune](https://mapgenie.io/call-of-duty-vanguard/maps/zombies-terra-maledicta?locationIds=1067403) inside the Bazaar and interact with it. - Head through the new portal that spawns to fight a boss. - Once defeated, the Decimator Shield will break free and will be useable. - The Decimator Shield acts as a weapon, taking up a weapon slot.

title: Terra Maledicta Main Easter Egg
description: Steps: - First, acquire the Decimator Shield by completing the [Decimator Shield Easter Egg](https://mapgenie.io/call-of-duty-vanguard/maps/zombies-terra-maledicta?locationIds=1067380). - Once acquired, head to the final [Ancient Corrupt Rune](https://mapgenie.io/call-of-duty-vanguard/maps/zombies-terra-maledicta?locationIds=1067417) and interact with it to spawn the final portal. - Head inside and use the alternative fire on the Decimator Shield to break the connections holding the Tome Page. - Once done, the red orb will fall. Interact with it to receive the Tome Page and a variety of loot once back in the desert.

title: The Archon Main Easter Egg
description: Steps: - First, build the [Pack-A-Punch Machine](https://mapgenie.io/call-of-duty-vanguard/maps/zombies-the-archon?locationIds=1084860) through the main quest, then interact with the [Stone Pedestal](https://mapgenie.io/call-of-duty-vanguard/maps/zombies-the-archon?locationIds=1084874) to place down the artifact. - After a short discussion, a portal will open to the Dark Aether. - Head inside and survive until Kortifex forces everyone to be downed, then he will teleport everyone back to the Stone Pedestal. - Next, three trials will need to be completed in any order: - Trial of Mindfulness - Around the [Obelisk](https://mapgenie.io/call-of-duty-vanguard/maps/zombies-the-archon?locationIds=1084882) on Merchant Road, dig up the nearby [Dig Spot](https://mapgenie.io/call-of-duty-vanguard/maps/zombies-the-archon?search=dig_spot%20%26%26%20category%3A28626) until a red orb spawns. - Follow it, then interact with it to spawn a series of symbols on the wall. - Remember the symbols and capture the runes in order of the symbols. - Complete this three times, then interact with the Obelisk to start the final trial. - Capture the runes on the ground that spawn. Once enough runes have been captures, the trial will complete. - Trial of Sacrifice - First, light three torches around the Derailment area with a molotov in order: 1. [Torch](https://mapgenie.io/call-of-duty-vanguard/maps/zombies-the-archon?locationIds=1084912) 2. [Torch](https://mapgenie.io/call-of-duty-vanguard/maps/zombies-the-archon?locationIds=1084913) 3. [Torch](https://mapgenie.io/call-of-duty-vanguard/maps/zombies-the-archon?locationIds=1084915) - Once the last one is lit, a red orb will spawn. - Sacrifice a Pack-A-Punched gun to the red orb and it'll head into the [Obelisk](https://mapgenie.io/call-of-duty-vanguard/maps/zombies-the-archon?locationIds=1084908) on the train car. - Switch to the Ring of Fire Artifact and interact with the Obelisk to start the trial. - Kill zombies near the central artifact until a Full Power power-up spawns, then head to one of the outer obelisks that spawned. - Use Ring of Fire on the Obelisk and kill zombies while standing inside of the circle to charge the Obelisk. - A red line will connect the outer Obelisk to the central Obelisk when fully charged. - Repeat until all four Obelisks are connected to the center to complete the trial. - Trial of Resilience - Head to the Debris Field and destroy the [Ruined Crystals](https://mapgenie.io/call-of-duty-vanguard/maps/zombies-the-archon?search=ruined_crystal%20%26%26%20category%3A28622) until a red orb spawns. - Follow the red orb, and three items will need to be collected and brought back to the orb: - [Cursed Officer's Hat](https://mapgenie.io/call-of-duty-vanguard/maps/zombies-the-archon?locationIds=1085003) - [Cursed Skull](https://mapgenie.io/call-of-duty-vanguard/maps/zombies-the-archon?locationIds=1085004) - [Cursed Femur](https://mapgenie.io/call-of-duty-vanguard/maps/zombies-the-archon?locationIds=1085009) - Once complete, grab the [Decimator Shield](https://mapgenie.io/call-of-duty-vanguard/maps/zombies-the-archon?locationIds=1085022) from the ground and interact with the [Obelisk](https://mapgenie.io/call-of-duty-vanguard/maps/zombies-the-archon?locationIds=1084998) to start the trial. - Syphoncores will spawn around the area. Use the Decimator Shield's alternate fire to destroy them, then interact with them to collect the blood. - Place the blood in the empty fountain in the Debris Field until the fountain is full, completing the trial. - Once all trials are completed, the portal will reopen to the Dark Aether. Heading into the portal will start the boss fight against Kortifex.

title: Mr. Peeks Ray Gun Easter Egg
description: Steps: - With the [Rampage Inducer](https://mapgenie.io/call-of-duty-vanguard/maps/zombies-the-archon?locationIds=1085105) active after completing the [Rampage Inducer Easter Egg](https://mapgenie.io/call-of-duty-vanguard/maps/zombies-the-archon?locationIds=1085031), a Mr. Peeks part will spawn in a random [Dig Spot](https://mapgenie.io/call-of-duty-vanguard/maps/zombies-the-archon?search=dig_spot%20%26%26%20category%3A28626) every five rounds. - After digging up the third Mr. Peeks part, a Ray Gun will drop.

title: Vanishing Shore Song Easter Egg
description: Steps: - Interact with the [Guitar](https://mapgenie.io/call-of-duty-vanguard/maps/zombies-the-archon?locationIds=1085111) on the second floor of the Radio Outpost three times to play the Vanishing Shore song.

title: Zombie Head Hunting Easter Egg
description: Steps: - After round five, a zombie will be hiding around outside the map. - The zombie will show up on the minimap. - If approached too closely, the zombies will disappear until next round. - Depending where it spawns, you will need to shoot it with a specific gun: - [Hiding Zombie](https://mapgenie.io/call-of-duty-vanguard/maps/zombies-the-archon?locationIds=1085194): SMG - [Hiding Zombie](https://mapgenie.io/call-of-duty-vanguard/maps/zombies-the-archon?locationIds=1085196): Assault Rifle - [Hiding Zombie](https://mapgenie.io/call-of-duty-vanguard/maps/zombies-the-archon?locationIds=1085159): Shotgun - Depending on which gun is required, when shot, you will be brought into a special trial: - Both trials require shooting a floating head until it is destroyed - SMG/Assault Rifle: - Shoot the blue orbs that the head spawns. If too many build up, the trial will fail. - Don't shoot the red orbs that the head spawns. If shot, the trial will fail. - Shotgun: - Shoot the floating head only when it's not red. If shot while red, the trial will fail. - If successfully completed, the head will reward you with 2,500 essence, a max ammo, and a chest with a Pack-A-Punched gun.
